description: An open coloring book lies on the table with a squid-like outline drawing on the right page, and a box of crayons sits to the right. The right hand reaches toward the crayon box, then comes back holding a pink crayon as a right-hand object and colors short strokes inside the squid’s body while the left hand rests on and steadies the open book as a left-hand object; the right hand then pauses and lifts slightly away, still holding the crayon.
